title: Item counts never pluralise in letters, board and quest text ('Could you spare 4 Turnip?', 'Maple needs 3 Turnip (board job).', 'Job taken: 3 Turnip for Maple')
repro: Read any favour letter or the plaza board: GameState.item_name(id) has no plural form, used with n>1 in Mail.morning favour text, GameState.board_accept quest text, town._board choice rows and the 'Job taken' toast.
fix: Add GameState.item_count_name(id, n) (n==1 -> name; else items.json 'plural' if present, else simple English rules: y->ies, s/sh/ch/x->es, mass nouns like Wood/Stone/Hay/Flour/Honey/Bait/Slime Goo/Coal/Milk/Linen/Cloth unchanged or '%d pieces of'); use it in Mail favour text + _act refusal, board_accept/board_restore text, town._board rows and toast.

title: Birthday tip letter always comes from Pip (or Wren jr), even if the player has never met Pip or Pip is away
repro: Mail._news: send('Wren jr' if id == 'pip' else 'Pip', ...) with no check that the sender is known/present; on day ~3 a Psst letter from a stranger kid arrives about a villager's birthday.
fix: Pick the sender from _known() friends of the birthday villager (prefer Pip/Wren jr if met and npc_present, else any other known villager, else sign it 'The town gossip' / send as Mayor Alder notice); pass {'npc': sender_id} so the letter gets a portrait/blip.

title: Festival reminder says 'Shops close for the day' but shops only shut 9am-6pm on festival days
repro: Mail._news festival letter vs TownHours.why_shut (festival closes shops 9.0-18.0 except the hall).
fix: Word it 'Shops shut from nine till six so everyone can come.' (matches TownHours).

title: Penguin welcome letter: 'My office in the hall is always open to you' but the town hall keeps 7-21 hours
repro: Mail._first_week penguin wmail_2 text vs TownHours.SHOPS hall [7,21].
fix: 'My office in the hall is open whenever the shops are.' or 'my door's always open in shop hours'.

title: Storm letter is signed 'Marlowe at the lighthouse' with no npc id, says 'Storm' for blizzards too
repro: Mail._news: send('Marlowe at the lighthouse', 'Storm coming in tomorrow...') for w in ['storm','blizzard']; sender doesn't match npc name Marlowe so no portrait/voice, and a blizzard letter says storm/don't bother watering (nothing to water in winter).
fix: send('Marlowe', ..., 'news', {'npc':'marlowe'}) with a blizzard variant: 'Blizzard coming tomorrow. Bring the animals in and stay near a fire.'

title: Favour letters ask for out-of-season crops and animal goods you can't have (strawberries in winter, Tam's wool with no sheep), with a 4-day deadline
repro: Mail._favour_item filters likes only by tier (<= progress_tier+1) and egg/milk/cheese building checks; no GameState.crop_in_season(id) check (the board has one) and no sheep/barn check for sheep_wool, so e.g. Maple/Posy/Mabel ask for strawberries in winter, Tam asks for Sheep Wool on day 5; the favour then always lapses ('Too late: they found it elsewhere').
fix: In _favour_item skip ids where not GameState.crop_in_season(id); gate sheep_wool (and other animal goods: wool, duck egg, truffle, cheese/butter/mayo) on the animal/building existing, mirroring board_today; also drop tier+1 items whose source building isn't built (beehive honey). Optionally prefer items the player has had (run.earned/shipped) for the stretch pick.

title: Letters sent mid-day arrive silently: keeper invitations (MegaTravel._mail on map enter) and Granite's floor-100 letter have no toast
repro: Mail.send only appends to run.mail; the 'you have mail' cue comes from the morning toast/farm marker. MegaTravel.on_enter posts the keeper letter whenever any map loads after the tier is reached (the travel point appears in the same instant), and mine.gd:2213 posts Granite's letter on floor 100; the player only finds them by chance.
fix: Give Mail.send an optional notify (default true when not called from Mail.morning): GameState.notify('A letter from %s is waiting in your mailbox.' % from) with a page/mail sfx; or have MegaTravel._mail call it. Keep morning letters on the existing morning toast.

title: Mailbox cap drops the oldest letter even if it's an untaken gift or open favour
repro: Mail.send: while list().size() > MAX_KEEP (30): pop_front(). With ~1 letter/day a gift left in the mailbox for a month (or a keeper invitation) is deleted silently.
fix: When over the cap, remove the oldest letter that is read and settled (chat/news read, gift got, favour done/lapsed); only if none, drop the oldest read one; never drop an unread letter or untaken gift (let the cap overflow a little).

title: Gift and chatter letters repeat one stock text for every villager (kids included): 'Found this and thought of you. Don't make a fuss.', 'The kettle's always on'
repro: Mail.morning gift letter uses one fixed sentence for every sender; chatter picks from 6 generic lines with no per-villager voice and no repeat guard, so Pip (a child) writes 'If you're passing, drop in. The kettle's always on.' and the same line can come twice in a row.
fix: Add a few gift/chatter lines per villager (or per kind: kid/elder/arc) in data (e.g. data/mail_lines.json via a small generator, or reuse quest_lines/npc 'chat' voice), fall back to the generic pool; remember the last line per sender in run.flags.mail_last to avoid repeats.

title: Renovation start letters say 'Workers start tomorrow' but the corner is taped off from that same morning
repro: RecReno.morning sets st[id] = [day, day+build] the day the start letter is sent; RecReno.blocked shows 'Taped off ... Open in 3 days' that day. gen_rec RENOVATIONS arcade_wing start text (both arcs): 'Workers start tomorrow' / 'Crew starts tomorrow'.
fix: Reword to 'Workers start today' / 'Crew's in from today' (or start the build next day in rec_reno.gd, but the text change is simpler).

title: First Rec Cup can be announced near a season's end ('Beat N before the season ends') with only a day or two left
repro: RecReno._cup fires the first morning after the trophy hall opens (rec_open + ~125 days, any day of season), keyed to the current season; gen_rec comment says it is announced on the season's first morning. If the hall opens on season day 26, the player gets 2 days.
fix: In _cup, if the trophy hall opened this season and fewer than ~10 days remain, key the first cup to next season and announce it on that season's first morning (or say 'this season's cup runs to the end of next season').

title: Ironline keeper letter says 'ticket booth by the town square'; the town calls it the plaza everywhere else
repro: gen_mega_new CONTENT['ironline'] mail text and home_name 'the town square' vs town.gd/letters/board ('the plaza').
fix: 'by the plaza' in mail and home_name.

title: Board note reads 'Market day at the the commons.' (double 'the')
repro: RecCenter.board_notes: 'Market day at the %s.' % Commons.short_name(), and short_name is 'the commons' / 'the lot garden' (gen_community_farm 'short'). Shows on the plaza board on every commons market day once the commons is complete.
fix: 'Market day at %s.' % Commons.short_name() (or capitalise: 'Market day at the commons today.').

title: Wren's day-3 penguin letter spells 'Dear neighbor' while every other letter uses 'neighbour'
repro: Mail.story_due penguin mail_2 'Dear neighbor,' vs Mayor Alder's welcome ('neighbour') and Hazel's commons letter ('Dear neighbour').
